note: _qui erat super omnes gazas_ – who had charge over all her treasures (Douay Version). _gaza_ – treasury is a Greek word, here simply transliterated from the Greek. The word is used only here in the Vulgate Bible, and rarely elsewhere. – Theodore A. Bergren: Greek Loanwords in the Vulgate New Testament and the Latin Apostolic Fathers. _Traditio_ 74 (2019) 1–25, at p. 18.
